evidence_states.MEASURED: A directly published count, price, time, location or observed change from the cited source.
evidence_states.PROXY: A real observation relevant to demand but not direct Buono demand or sales.
evidence_states.INFERRED: A reasoned model implication derived from one or more measured or proxy observations.
evidence_states.UNKNOWN: Not established by accessible evidence and not estimated as fact.
